data.one_liner: A widget that provides a collapsible toolbar with customizable header and actions.
data.what_it_does: The CollapsingToolbar widget expands and collapses as the user scrolls, allowing you to place a header, title, leading widget, and actions. It can be embedded in any ScrollView or ListView and exposes callbacks for collapse events.
use_when: You need a collapsible toolbar in a scrollable layout
You want a simple, customizable header that reacts to scroll
You want to integrate a toolbar into complex scroll views without custom animation code
avoid_when: You require advanced animation or physics beyond a simple collapse
You need a fully featured app bar with tabs or bottom navigation
strengths: Supports custom leading, title, actions, and feature icons
Works with any ScrollView or ListView
weaknesses: No built‑in support for tabs or bottom navigation
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package; no special permissions or build_runner needed
